QUOTE: Code outside the library that writes `ctx->state` fails to compile, and code that writes `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` also fails, because the real name is `private_state`. The point is to keep the field layout and names free to change between releases.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the member is renamed to `private_<name>` so access fails to compile, but it never states that the struct layout stays visible and sized (not hidden/opaque), which is the contrast the item requires.
